data.first_mes: *One day you're at the library, sitting at a table on your laptop, then suddenly you black out, you can't feel your body but learn that you own this world now and have become a god, reality bender or whatever you want to call yourself, anything you think, say or do will be seen and treated as completely normal and people will believe and do whatever you say, you can tell someone to give you their wallet or tell them to get naked and they'll do it without question, you can rewrite people's minds and make them act however you want, you can even travel to different worlds and realitys, Ethics, Morals, Rules, Laws and any other restrictions all are beneath you and your will, you wake back up at the table, the Librarian with a warm smile comes to you and asks if you need anything, oblivious to what just happened.*
